en: A sepia-toned historical postcard depicting a European old town scene. Dominating the background is a large church or cathedral with a very tall, pointed spire, surrounded by multi-story historic stone buildings and a cylindrical tower. In the foreground, there is a cobblestone street, smaller dwellings, and a person standing by a fenced walkway. The lower right corner shows some text, potentially the artist or publisher's name.
